jobs.description:
Do you enjoy coaching a team, solving customer issues and improving how things work?
 

For an international B2B company in 
Zaventem, MetiSelect is looking for a 
Customer Service Team Leader.
 

You will lead a team of 
four to five Customer Care colleagues and work closely with the Regional Business Manager. Alongside the daily team coordination, you will follow up on commercial agreements, prepare reports and help improve the service provided to customers and business partners.
 

You make sure your team knows what needs to happen, has the support to do it and follows customer requests through to completion.
 

Your responsibilities include the following.
 
 

•  

Lead and coach your team. Organise the workload, coordinate leave, support new colleagues and follow up on individual and team performance.
  

•  

Help resolve complex customer issues. Work with Sales, Finance and Supply Chain to find solutions and keep customers informed.
  

•  

Manage an existing partner relationship. Be the main operational contact for one business partner in Turkey, discussing open requests and coordinating follow-up internally.
  

•  

Follow up on commercial agreements. Keep track of pricing updates, contract deadlines, renewals and agreed discounts, working with the relevant colleagues in Sales, Finance and Legal.
  

•  

Use data to improve service. Prepare reports and maintain dashboards to monitor response times, open requests and commercial results.
  

•  

Improve processes. Investigate recurring problems and work with colleagues, including IT, to make workflows clearer and more efficient.
  

•  

Support the use of Salesforce. Help maintain accurate customer information and, as you become familiar with the system, support colleagues with questions and consistent ways of working.
  
 

•  

You have experience in 
B2B customer service, sales support, order management or commercial operations. You enjoy helping people develop while staying involved in the daily work.
  

•  

You bring 
at least five years of relevant experience, including experience directly managing a team.
  

•  

You have coached colleagues, set priorities and followed up on their performance.
  

•  

You understand how customer requests, commercial agreements and internal processes connect.
  

•  

You are comfortable using 
Excel, reports and KPIs to identify problems and decide what needs attention.
  

•  

You have worked with an 
ERP system, such as SAP or Dynamics. 
Salesforce experience is a strong advantage. Training can be considered if your wider experience fits the role.
  

•  

You communicate confidently in 
professional English. German or Italian is a plus.
  

•  

You take initiative, keep track of commitments and involve the right people to get things resolved.

jobs.occupation: Inside Sales – English + Eastern European Languages
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy turning commercial opportunities into successful sales? Are you motivated by achieving targets and building long-term customer relationships?
 

Then this opportunity might be the perfect fit for you!
 

As an 
Inside Sales Representative, your main focus will be on managing an existing customer portfolio, reactivating former customers, and following up on warm leads who have already shown interest in the platform or available vehicles.
 

Your responsibilities:
 
 

•  

Manage and develop an existing portfolio of B2B customers.
  

•  

Reconnect with former customers and identify opportunities to reactivate commercial relationships.
  

•  

Follow up on warm leads who have already expressed interest in the platform or available vehicles.
  

•  

Maintain regular contact with customers by phone and digital communication channels.
  

•  

Understand customer needs and advise them on suitable vehicles.
  

•  

Convert commercial opportunities into sales and actively work towards individual and team targets.
  

•  

Prepare quotations, manage contracts, and ensure accurate follow-up of sales activities.
  

•  

Collaborate closely with the sales team to improve customer satisfaction and commercial performance.
  
 

•  

You have previous experience in sales or a commercially oriented position.
  

•  

You are genuinely passionate about sales and motivated by achieving results.
  

•  

You enjoy convincing customers, closing deals, and reaching commercial targets.
  

•  

You have an interest in the automotive industry or are eager to learn more about it.
  

•  

You are fluent in English and at least one Eastern European language.
  

•  

You are confident, persuasive, proactive, and not afraid to take initiative.
  

•  

You have strong communication skills and enjoy building customer relationships.
  

•  

You work in a structured and accurate manner.
  

•  

You are a team player who can also work independently.

To support the continued growth of our Trademark & Design practice, we are looking for a highly skilled Senior Trademark & Design Attorney / Legal Counsel to join our team.
 

This position offers the opportunity to work on a broad range of trademark, design and related intellectual property matters for Belgian and international clients, ranging from innovative start-ups to multinational corporations.

About the job
 
 

• Advising clients ranging from innovative start-ups to multinational companies on trademark, design and related IP matters. 

• Managing national, European and international trademark and design portfolios. 

• Conducting trademark clearance searches and providing availability opinions. 

• Drafting, filing and prosecuting trademark and design applications before the BOIP, EUIPO, WIPO and foreign intellectual property offices. 

• Handling opposition, cancellation and invalidity proceedings. 

• Advising on infringement, unfair competition and IP enforcement strategies. 

• Drafting legal opinions, cease-and-desist letters, coexistence agreements, assignments, licence agreements, collaboration and R&D agreements. 

• Assisting clients in developing and implementing pragmatic IP protection strategies. 

• Liaising with clients, foreign associates and intellectual property offices worldwide. 

• Actively managing and developing a client base. 

• Monitoring legislative and case law developments and translating these into practical advice and trainings for clients. 

• Working closely with a team of experienced attorneys, legal professionals and paralegals.  

Your profile
 
 

• Education: Master's degree in Law, preferably with an additional qualification in Intellectual Property. 

• Experience: At least 5 years of experience in IP law and/or trademark and design protection, preferably in private practice. 

• Languages: Excellent written and oral communication skills in Dutch and English; other languages are a plus. 

• Mindset: Pragmatic, proactive, client-oriented, and self-motivated. 

• Skills: Attention to detail, ability to handle confidential cases discreetly, and strong prioritization skills. 

• Teamwork: Ability to work both individually and seamlessly within a team.

For a leading player in the Belgian logistics sector, we are looking for a CE Driver for the Ghent site.

For the Ghent site, we are looking for a CE Driver who enjoys working with a dedicated tractor unit and a flexible day schedule.

jobs.occupation: CONTENT CREATOR BEAUTY AND LIFESTYLE – NL/FR/ENG (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
Deluge is seeking a creative and hands-on Content Creator to strengthen our brand presence and tell our story across digital channels. 
 

 As our Content Creator, you will:
 
 

• Develop and execute the content strategy for Deluge across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and other platforms. 

• Create and edit high-quality photo and video content for campaigns, product launches, and day-to-day storytelling. 

• Coordinate and manage content creation for digital platforms, newsletters, PR, and print materials. 

• Collaborate with external parties to create high-end content. 

• Collaborate closely with the founders to ensure all content aligns with Deluge’s tone, values, and aesthetic. 

• Monitor trends and translate them into creative concepts for luxury audiences. 

• Manage and plan the content calendar and publish posts consistently. 

• Create website visuals, and other marketing materials, such as newsletters. 

• Support influencer collaborations and event coverage. 

• Prepare shoots for upcoming campaigns. 

•  Organize and promote events, brand activations, and partnerships. 
 

• You have at least 3-5 years of experience in content creation, social media, or digital marketing -ideally within the beauty, fashion, or lifestyle industry. You have experience with Shopify and e-commerce. 

• You have a strong sense of visual storytelling, branding, and aesthetics. 

• You’re skilled in photography, videography, and editing tools. 

• You understand social media trends and know how to adapt them to a luxury brand voice. 

•  You have experience managing social media, newsletters, and website content. 

• You’re proactive, detail-oriented, and full of ideas. 

• You’re fluent in Dutch, French, and English. 

• You understand influencer marketing and community building. 

• You have a deep passion for beauty, design, and lifestyle experiences.

Our client is a Brussels-based company operating in a technical and regulated environment, with an international scope. It stands out for its pragmatic mindset, family-oriented culture, high-quality approach and products, as well as its continuous drive to modernize internal tools and processes.As part of its digital transformation and the structuring of its IT function, our client is looking to strengthen its team by recruiting an IT Coordinator who will play a central role between users, management, and external partners.

As an IT Coordinator, you will hold a key, cross-functional position, combining both operational and organizational responsibilities.You will cover the full IT scope: user support, infrastructure, business applications, and coordination of external service providers.You will actively contribute to the company's digitalization and ensure the continuity, reliability, and ongoing development of its IT systems.Your responsibilities :

• Provide Level 1 and Level 2 IT support to users (workstations, software, access, etc.).
• Manage and maintain IT infrastructure (networks, servers, cloud environments, security).
• Administer and optimize business applications in collaboration with an external consultant (CRM, webshop, internal tools, Office 365, etc.).
• Lead IT projects (new tools, improvements, migrations) in collaboration with various departments (e.g. CRM implementation project).
• Coordinate and manage external IT vendors and service providers.
• Identify innovation opportunities and propose continuous improvements to systems and processes.
• Support users and management through change and the adoption of new tools

Profile

• Minimum 5 years of experience in an IT coordination role or similar position.
• Versatile profile, comfortable with support, infrastructure, applications, and project management.
• Experience working with external IT service providers.
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office 365 and collaborative environments.
• Excellent organizational, autonomy, and communication skills.
• Strong sense of innovation and a genuine ability to support change.
• Languages: French and English required; Dutch is a strong asset (trilingual profile is a major plus).

jobs.occupation: Senior Business Analyst – BPMN & Stakeholder Management
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Identify and structure business requirements even when they are implicit, incomplete, or ambiguous.
• Facilitate workshops to guide stakeholders toward clear decision-making and requirements stabilization.
• Model AS-IS and TO-BE business processes using BPMN standards to identify improvement opportunities.
• Translate business needs into formal user stories, acceptance criteria, and wireframes.
• Collaborate closely with technical teams and functional analysts to ensure solutions align with business objectives.

Requirements

• 8+ years in Business Analysis including the independent management of complex analysis tracks.
• 8+ years in Stakeholder Management and Facilitation within expert-driven environments.
• 5+ years in Business Process Modeling using BPMN and requirement traceability.
• 5+ years experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies, including User Stories and Acceptance Criteria.
• You have a strong understanding of ICT environments to evaluate the impact of technical choices.
• You bring advanced leadership skills to drive convergence and meet project deadlines.
• You possess strong analytical skills and the ability to challenge business requests critically.
• You are Native Dutch or Native French with good knowledge of the second language and active knowledge of English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with Functional Analysis.
• Proven experience in creating wireframes or mock-ups to validate requirements.

Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and maintain modern software solutions using the .NET framework.
• Perform technical analysis and translate business needs into robust application code.
• Collaborate closely with architects and analysts to ensure alignment with development standards.
• Execute testing, integration, and support activities for business-critical systems.
• Implement scalable and maintainable solutions in a fast-paced agile environment.

Requirements

• You have 8+ years of experience in backend development with .NET 8 and .NET 10.
• You bring extensive expertise in building applications with both WPF and Blazor.
• You possess strong knowledge of SQL, MongoDB, and RabbitMQ.
• You're experienced in developing and integrating REST API services.
• You bring proficiency in Azure DevOps and SEQ.
• You possess good communication skills and take accountability for your tasks.
• You are fluent in English with a good level of Dutch and/or French.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with SignalR.

jobs.occupation: Senior IT Project Manager – Application Delivery & Azure DevOps
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Manage the end-to-end IT delivery of assigned projects, ensuring strict control over scope, planning, budget, and quality.
• Lead and mentor a multidisciplinary team, overseeing daily operations, priorities, and professional development.
• Maintain the application portfolio by balancing project requirements, maintenance needs, and technological evolutions.
• Collaborate with business stakeholders and ICT teams to ensure transparent reporting on risks, dependencies, and progress.
• Optimize the application development lifecycle, coordinating activities from analysis through to deployment and go-live.
• Implement resource capacity planning to ensure efficient use of team members across various project and maintenance tasks.

Requirements

• You possess 8+ years of experience in IT Project Management, including the management of planning, budgets, and risk mitigation.
• You bring 5+ years of experience in Team Leadership and people management within a technical environment.
• You have 5+ years of experience managing the Application Development Lifecycle (SDLC), specifically in environments combining projects and maintenance.
• You possess 3+ years of experience working with Azure DevOps for project tracking and coordination.
• You have a strong technical background in Application Architectures to effectively challenge technical proposals.
• You're analytically strong with a proactive approach to risk identification and escalation.
• You're an effective communicator capable of bridging the gap between business and IT stakeholders.
• You are fluent in Dutch and French with an active knowledge of English.
Nice to Haves

• Knowledge of .NET, C#, and SQL.
• Experience with APIs and CI/CD environments.

For the campus of DHL in Bornem, we are looking for order pickers with ETP experience and the necessary ETP certificate. You will work in a dynamic team, where you will work in the alternating shift (6 a.m. to 2 p.m. & 2 p.m. to 10 p.m.). 
 

As an order picker, your duties will include the following tasks: 
 

 
• Collecting/picking orders using a combi truck (+/- up to 9 metres working height) 
 
• Applying shipping labels to orders
 
• Loading and unloading trucks, this can be either manually or with an electric transpallet (ETP). 
 
• Taking care of administration: this may involve processing delivery notes 
 
• Quality control of goods dn packaging of goods.
 
• We are looking for order pickers who are keen to prove themselves across the warehouse and in any position. 

As an order picker, you can relate to the following description: 
 

 
• You already have experience in the logistics sector.
 
• You have your own transport to get to the warehouse. (Not accessible by public transport )

• You can perform your tasks accurately and correctly.
 
• A real team player.
 
• You are stress-resistant and always remain customer-friendly under difficult circumstances.
 
• You consider quality of paramount importance.
 
• A good basic knowledge of Dutch or English.

We are seeking an experienced and commercially minded Partnerships, Engagement & Development Officer to help strengthen BSB's external profile, contribute to student enrolment growth and support the development of future fundraising and community engagement initiatives. 
  
Reporting to the Marketing & Admissions Director, you will build and manage strategic relationships with organisations, businesses, embassies, international networks and community groups that can help connect prospective families with BSB. You will also help develop partnership and fundraising opportunities that support the School's long-term objectives.
  Key Responsibilities  Partnership Development    
• Identify, develop and maintain strategic relationships with businesses, embassies, international organisations, relocation providers, chambers of commerce and community groups.  
• Build a strong network of external partners who can support student recruitment, community engagement and the School's wider strategic objectives.  
• Create and manage partnership initiatives that deliver mutual value and long-term engagement.   Business Development & Outreach    
• Proactively identify new opportunities to increase awareness of BSB and generate interest from prospective families and key stakeholders.  
• Develop outreach activities and engagement initiatives that strengthen BSB's visibility within the international community.  
• Represent BSB at networking events, conferences, community activities and professional forums.   Admissions & Enrolment Support    
• Work closely with Admissions and Marketing colleagues to develop referral channels and partnership opportunities that support enrolment growth.  
• Help identify and engage new audiences and communities that may be interested in BSB.  
• Monitor the effectiveness of outreach and partnership activities and make recommendations for continuous improvement.   Fundraising & Development    
• Support the development of sponsorship, fundraising and philanthropic initiatives that strengthen the School's long-term development goals.  
• Identify and cultivate relationships with potential sponsors, donors and supporters.  
• Assist in developing engagement opportunities that encourage long-term investment in the BSB community.   Stakeholder Engagement    
• Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, acting as an ambassador for BSB at all times.  
• Work collaboratively across departments to maximise partnership opportunities and ensure a joined-up approach to engagement activities.  
• Maintain regular contact with key partners and ensure relationships remain active and mutually beneficial.   Performance & Continuous Improvement    
• Maintain accurate records of partnership activity, stakeholder engagement and business development opportunities.  
• Monitor outcomes and trends, evaluating the impact of initiatives and identifying opportunities for growth.  
• Provide regular insights and recommendations that support future planning and decision-making. 
Essential    
• Demonstrable success in business development, partnership development, account management, fundraising or a related relationship-driven role.  
• Proven ability to develop new relationships and convert opportunities into measurable outcomes.  
• Experience identifying and pursuing new opportunities, rather than solely managing existing accounts.  
• Experience managing multiple opportunities and priorities simultaneously and delivering against agreed objectives.  
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data and insights to inform decisions and improve performance.  
• Experience forecasting outcomes, identifying risks and taking proactive action to maintain progress.  
• Strong stakeholder-management, networking, influencing and relationship-building skills.  
• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.  
• Excellent organisational, communication and presentation skills.  
• Excellent spoken and written English.      
Desirable
    
• Experience working with international organisations, multinational companies, embassies, diplomatic communities, relocation organisations or professional networks.  
• An established professional network within Belgium and/or relevant international communities.  
• Experience in fundraising, sponsorship, philanthropy or corporate partnerships.  
• Experience within education, international education or another relationship-driven environment.  
• Experience supporting student recruitment, admissions, customer acquisition or business growth activities.  
• French and/or Dutch language skills.   Candidate Profile    
• Commercial focus: Understands how strong relationships translate into tangible outcomes and sustainable growth.  
• Business development instinct: Enjoys creating opportunities, opening doors and building new connections.  
• Relationship builder: Establishes credibility quickly and develops trusted relationships across cultures, sectors and levels of seniority.  
• Strategic thinker: Able to identify opportunities, assess priorities and focus effort where it will have the greatest impact.  
• Results-oriented: Takes ownership, follows through and delivers against agreed objectives.  
• Analytical: Uses evidence, insight and good judgement to inform decisions and recommend action.  
• Resilient and proactive: Maintains momentum, follows up consistently and remains focused on long-term goals.  
• Collaborative: Works effectively with colleagues across functions to achieve shared objectives.  
• Professional and discreet: Exercises sound judgement and represents BSB with credibility and integrity.  
• International mindset: Values diversity and thrives in an international and multilingual environment.   What Success Looks Like    
• Development of a strong portfolio of active strategic partnerships.  
• Increased awareness of BSB amongst key external audiences and communities.  
• A measurable contribution to enrolment growth through partnership and outreach activities.  
• Growth in fundraising, sponsorship or development opportunities.  
• Strong engagement and retention of key partners and stakeholders.  
• Effective identification and progression of new opportunities and networks.

Your responsibilities include:
  
Production & Planning
    
• Organize and coordinate the daily operations of the cutting, deboning, and packaging processes based on customer orders.  
• Monitor productivity, carcass yield, and production lead times, taking corrective action where necessary.  
• Coordinate production activities with sales and transport to ensure daily deliveries leave on time.   
 
  
People Management
    
• Lead, motivate, and coach a team of 15 employees, including butchers, meat cutters, packers, and drivers.  
• Prepare staff schedules and monitor attendance, leave, and training.  
• Participate in the recruitment, onboarding, and evaluation of new employees.   
 
  
Quality & Food Safety
    
• Work together with the quality department to ensure the site complies with IFS, ACS, and FASFC regulations.  
• Monitor hygiene, cold chain management, and traceability on the production floor and take action when deviations occur.  
• Assist in preparing for audits and inspections and follow up on corrective actions.   
 
  
Infrastructure, Maintenance & Safety
    
• Take responsibility for buildings, refrigeration systems, machinery, and production lines.  
• Coordinate maintenance and repairs with internal technicians and external partners.  
• Ensure workplace safety, employee well-being, and good housekeeping standards.   
 
  
Transport & Logistics
    
• Manage the company's fleet of refrigerated trucks and the drivers.  
• Organize daily route planning to ensure every delivery reaches the customer on time and in full.  
• Monitor cold chain compliance during transport and oversee fleet maintenance, inspections, and legal requirements.   
 
  
Monitoring & Continuous Improvement
    
• Monitor KPIs (yield, productivity, costs, complaints, and waste) and report to management. 
  
• Bachelor's degree level or equivalent through experience.  
• At least 5 years of experience in a management role within production, preferably in the meat or food industry.  
• Practical experience with food safety standards (IFS, HACCP, ACS, FASFC) and audit processes.  
• Hands-on leader: visible on the shop floor and capable of motivating a team of skilled professionals.  
• Stress-resistant and decisive: able to maintain oversight in a fast-paced production environment with demanding delivery schedules.  
• Structured, with a strong focus on numbers, processes, and continuous improvement.  
• Fluent in Dutch and English. Additional languages are considered an asset in our multilingual team.  
• Flexible: willing to start early when required to oversee production at the beginning of the shift. Production starts at 3:00 a.m.

•

Are you commercially minded and do you enjoy working with customers? Are you looking for a job that is never the same and where you get opportunities to grow?

Then maybe you are our new CUSTOMER CARE REPRESENTATIVE!

For our client, the largest private rail freight operator in Europe, we are looking for a customer care representative to join the Freight Force.

As a customer care representative you will: Process owner for the booking & check-in process
  
• You accept bookings on customer request  
• You make bookings yourself of containers and wagons on trains and you send the booking instructions and agreements to Order Management  
• You inform and make the customer acquainted with the Customer Portal so that he is able to makes his own bookings. You assist the customer in every step of the booking process.  
• You manage changes of the original booking  
• You check if basic commercial data is known and is supported via the Customer Portal. If no, you inform and request assistance from Inside Sales to amend lacking commercial information  
• You rectify the missing and/or wrong contract number for import orders to ensure quick O2C  
• You make sure that all booking details are correct and that there are no anomalies that can slow down the order-to-cash process  
• You prepare template of the railway bill/consignment note.  
• You make the consignment note (as a paid service or if in high special need for assistance)
Commercial tasks
  
• You are able to maximize the fill rate of each train by finding the extra box/wagon and by consulting the customer on a professional and commercial way (based on parameters of Commercial Margin Management)  
• You manage the customer relation daily and (pro-) actively to create a lock-in opportunity and retain Customer satisfaction.  
• You build a customer relationship through high standard service delivery and execution.  
• You highten awareness and inform the client of successful products  
• You inform and share knowledge with other stake-holders within the company to inform and update on this new transport relation
Customer behavior
  
• You discuss and try to understand the booking behaviors and needs of the Customer via commercial discussions based on KPI’s (in relation to SLA)  
• You sharing info about the customer behavior with commercial stake-holders (commercial Margin Management/Key accountmanagers/Inside Sales/...)
Communication
  
• You are pro-actively by thinking with the customer, assessing and acting before possible incidents.  
• You assure the tracking & tracing (within office hours) via Customer Portal and other ways (digitalization is key and our future aim)  
• You receive and assist the Customer with his complaint within our organisation and stakeholders

Who are we looking for?

As a Customer Service Representative, you are primarily focused on customer service. You have a commercial mentality and are able to communicate with the customer in a professional way.
  
• You have a bachelor degree or equivalent through experience;  
• You have strong communication skills and are able to understand and translate the customers needs;  
• You speak English fluently. A good knowledge of French and Dutch is required. Knowledge of German or another language is a plus;  
• You have experience in managing an account and you are able to work on customer relations and loyalty;  
• You have knowledge of the various Microsoft Office programs and are quick to learn proprietary systems;  
• You are organized, detail-oriented and have the drive to work in a commercial and professional manner;  
• You have the necessary persuasiveness and commercial flair, are proactive and can work alone as well as in a team;  
• You are a multitasker and are someone who values efficiency;  
• You can cope with a changing environment.

Our client is a dynamic and growing company in the region of Oostende.
